title: Bedtime Examination of Conscience
text:
O my God, I adore you
and I love you with all my heart.
I thank you for having created me,
made me a Christian,
and preserved me this day.
Forgive me the evil I have done this day
and if I have done any good,
accept it.
Watch over me as I take my rest
and deliver me from all danger.
May your grace be always with me
and with all those dear to me.
Amen.
notes: This bedtime prayer combines a brief examination of conscience with thanksgiving and petition for protection. It's perfect for those who want to end their day with reflection on their relationship with God, seeking forgiveness for failures and expressing gratitude for blessings.
description: Bedtime prayer combining examination of conscience with thanksgiving
